notes.title: Upcoming updates on the way!
notes.content:
The investigation will not end there!

In the coming months there will be updates for all our players where we will add more content and fix certain bugs that have happened to many of our players.

What will be new in the new updates?

- Subtitles added to videos and cinematics

- New configuration menu for the game

- 1 free DLC and 2 paid DLC

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171030/e921799013528443ec25091c7cdebedb7f0dc534.jpg
- Options to remove low audio quality filtering

- Text correction

- Implementing accessibility options for color blindness

- Free multiplier?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171030/75a412625705d6badc1b52d50707bb92a163681c.jpg
- More languages

- VR Edition

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171030/31115c47638538849aba06f11431c793e5e01e1d.jpg

All this new list will be added during the updates, this to give more immersion and more possibilities for many of our players can enjoy 100% to the comfort that you deserve.

More content for all of you, more ways to enjoy VETITUM_VRC

Our quest continues, do you think you will make it to the end?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171030/fb45586fb6c271b391561f1b84d4b89d7ab85fe0.png

notes.title: UPDATE 1.13
notes.content:
Discover the new secrets of the VHS with the new video available in an area of the game you jumped through ;)

This new version brings the following improvements
- Video execution in parkour level
- Restart at the house level if you do the secret path on the roof.
- More lighting and guidance in the real ending
- DualS Easter Egg (I had to do it xD)
- New video in Extras
- VHS Menu bug during Hospital
- Safety restart if you fall off the map

If you find bugs report it to "Astral Dream Team" and enjoy this new version of "VETITUM_VRC".
